subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: Knight Capital's 45 Minutes
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Knight Capital's 45 Minutes.

hook.text: In 45 minutes a trading firm lost $440 million because old test code was accidentally deployed to production.

buildup.text: Knight Capital deployed new software to 8 servers. But one server still had old code with a test flag enabled.

discovery.text: The old code executed millions of unintended trades. By the time they noticed, they'd lost $10 million per minute.

twist.text: There was no kill switch. The team had to manually stop each server while losses mounted every second.

climax.text: Knight Capital went bankrupt within days. Forty-five minutes of a deployment error ended a $1.5 billion company.

punchline.text: One server. Old test code. $440 million gone in 45 minutes.

quiz.question: What caused Knight Capital's $440 million loss?
options: Old test code accidentally deployed to production
